response:
Done. Both deliverables are in `baseline/out/`, and all internal-consistency checks pass.

**What I built** — a 75-second Douyin 口播 skeleton for 二手书循环, structured as 7 timed sections that map 1:1 onto the three required points:

| 段落 | 时长 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 钩子 | 0–4s | 反常识开场「全校闲置教材能压出一座图书馆」 |
| 痛点 | 4–11s | 宿舍楼道的书堆，建立共鸣并亮出主角身份 |
| 观点一 | 11–28s | 教材按学期末集中回收（「一本书只有前两周值钱」） |
| 观点二 | 28–47s | 封面破损 A/B/C/D 四档再定价，反转点「评级不是压价，是分流」 |
| 观点三 | 47–63s | 咖啡馆换书桌跨界引流，把人流变回收订单 |
| 收束 | 63–71s | 可记忆的金句 |
| CTA | 71–75s | 评论区报校名，只索低成本动作 |

`骨架.md` is the human-readable version (逐字稿 + 节奏表 + 4 条标题候选 + 封面文案 + 标签 + 发布时段建议 + 可拆分复用说明); `structure.json` is the machine-readable twin with per-section start/end/duration, on-screen text, visual cues, and a structured `pricing_tiers` array for the A/B/C/D grading rule.

**One thing worth flagging:** my first draft's script ran523 characters against a declared 75-second runtime — at the real ~5 字/秒 口播 pace that would have been a 109-second video, not 75s, and every section was over budget. I caught it on verification, cut the script to 381 characters, and recomputed every timestamp from the actual character counts. The file now states `duration_sec: 75`, `script_chars: 381`, `speech_rate_cps: 5.1`, and a verification pass confirms the timeline is continuous, every segment's stated duration and char count match the text, all per-section speaking rates land in a 4.75–5.21 字/秒 band, and each of the three brief points maps to exactly one `value_point` section in order. I also fixed a U+FFFD corruption that crept into the first draft's overview table.

Note on method: this is the baseline arm (`baseline_has_skill: false`), so I worked from the brief alone and deliberately did not open the treatment arm's `hot-templates` skill, to keep the A/B comparison honest.
